title: Checkpoint: full FRQ, timed
prompt:
The complete weather FRQ in one class: `WarmWeek` with

- field `private double[] readings;`
- constructor storing the array
- `public int coldHours()` — count of readings < 0.0
- `public boolean hasWarmDay()` — true if any reading > 25.0
- `public double firstBelow()` — the FIRST reading below 0.0, or 999.0 if none

Implement the full class.

tests.name: full frq class
tests.hint: Three independent behaviors over one stored array; firstBelow returns early on the first match.
